notes.title: Development Update: Progress, Fixes, and More!
notes.notes:
Hello to all Natural Elements Online adventurers

We want to share with you some important developments in our magical open world. While there's still a long way to go, we're moving forward steadily and eagerly.
[hr][/hr]Recent News!
Quest System Completed! The quest system is now fully functional. This will allow players to experience adventures, unlock unique challenges, and delve deeper into the lore of the Natural Elements Online world.

Multiplayer Testing Underway! We've begun the first multiplayer tests, allowing players to interact, collaborate, and explore the NAEL universe together. Feedback from these tests will help us improve the co-op experience before launch.

🔧 Improvements and Fixes: We're actively working on fixing reported bugs in key systems like skills, navigation, and progression. Each patch brings us closer to a more stable and fluid game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631587/5d6eea8a7874a4d7e5f8ed372de5aa045a141613.png"]
[hr][/hr]Your support is key!
If you haven't already, we invite you to add Natural Elements Online to your Steam wishlist. Not only will this keep you up to date with future updates, but it also helps us as developers a lot!
